prompt: Investigate why trial-to-paid conversion dropped after the Oct 3 pricing page change. Dana needs a one-page brief by Friday to decide whether to roll back. Everything is in ./evidence.
assertions: States a gate or confidence score of 95 or above, with evidence from CLAUDE.md or the message
